parish church monday 2nd/tuesday 3rd at 8.30pm. saturday 7th at 6.30pm; sunday 8th at 12noon. monday 9th/tuesday 10th at 8.30pm. friary: - monday to saturday 10.00am sunday 8.30am and 11.00am. ballinhassig parish newsletter for ballygarvan, ballyheada and goggins hill vol. 35 no. 8 sunday: november 1st, 2026 (all saints) remembrance and thanksgiving for our loved ones mary o’hwrites…. many people find november a difficult month, those who have been recently bereaved and those who carry the scars from a past painful bereavement. most of november we concentrate on remembering our deceased loved ones: - the holy souls novena, the visits to the graveyard, while these are spiritually good for us they make it impossible for people to avoid being revisited by the pain and loss of a loved one. we hold dear the memory of those who have been a truly significant part of each of us. the gift of memory and its place within our hearts brings us consolation . our hearts are warmed by the comfort of others and slowly over time we begin to heal and embrace life once again as our loved ones would wish us to live. we ask god to heal our pain and sadness as the month of november is a time of remembrance and thanksgiving for the lives of our loved ones , no matter how long or short that earthly life was. reflection:- holy souls are special people whom from us god did call we are left here broken hearted for we love them one and all. all we have left is just our memories of the times when they were near longing for those precious moments wishing they were here. but death is not the end for us it is just an open door where some day we will be with them with more happiness that before. once again with all our loved ones all our sorrow it will end in god’s home we’ll be re united parents, family and friends. so in this special holy month remember them and pray those holy souls our own dear loved ones to god are on their way. the sky is still as blue, the grass is still as green, the birds sing as sweetly, the flowers have not lost their fragrance, it may not seem so at the moment but slowly it will. ballinhassig
